# PANELEDU

> PANELEDU helps Turkish-speaking students find, compare and apply to university programs abroad. The catalog lists 23,000+ bachelor and master programs at 300+ universities in 17 countries, with tuition, duration, intake, English requirements, rankings and a link to each program's official page where available.

## Main pages
- [Programs](https://paneledu.com/programs): search and filter all programs. Shareable filters: ?q=, ?country=, ?type=, ?field=, ?budget=free|lt5|5-10|10-15|gt15, ?scholarship=1, ?eng=IELTS
- [Find a school](https://paneledu.com/match): a short questionnaire that returns matching universities
- [Universities](https://paneledu.com/university?id=1): one page per university, e.g. /university?id=<id>
- [Blog](https://paneledu.com/blog): country guides and application articles (RSS: /blog/feed.xml)
- [English level test](https://paneledu.com/test): free 20-question CEFR test
- [Sitemap](https://paneledu.com/sitemap.xml)

## Public JSON API (read-only, no key)
- GET /api/public/programs/search?q=&country=&type=&field=&budget=&scholarship=1&eng=&sort=name|fee-asc|fee-desc|qs&page=1&per=24
- GET|POST /api/public/match : school matching. Send a student profile (degree, fields, english, budget, region, apib) and get ranked schools with reasons. Schema: GET /api/public/match/schema
- GET /api/public/universities and /api/public/universities/<id>
- GET /api/public/filter-options (countries, degree types, fields, totals)

## Notes
- Site language is Turkish by default with an English toggle (stored in localStorage key paneleduLang).
- Program details are compiled from universities' official pages; confirm fees and dates on the official page before applying.
